correctness.rationale: For octahedron conv±e_i and E=u⊥ with u Haar-uniform up to sign, projection polarity gives (P_E O)^polar=[-1,1]^3∩E; center symmetry guarantees unrestricted inradius equals inverse farthest cube-section radius. Sorting |u| into a≥b≥c≥0 and examining cube-section vertices with two fixed signs gives R²=2+((b+c)/a)² when a≥b+c, else 2+((a-c)/b)². The competing cases satisfy the inequalities in RESULT.md, meeting continuously at a=b+c. At threshold R²≤2+s² (0≤s≤1), each branch is a simplicial cone in one positive sorted chamber, rays ((1,0,0),(1,s,0),(2,s,s)) and ((1,1,1-s),(1,1,1),(1+s,1,1)). Each determinant has absolute value s². The known solid-angle formula, multiplied by 48/(4π), yields exactly 24/π times the sum of two arctans, with stated denominators D1,D2, G(0)=0,G(1)=1 and support [1/√3,1/√2]. Smooth spherical level boundaries have measure zero. Independent double-precision cone determinant/angle checks at s∈{0,.1,.25,.5,.75,1} passed; the source exact-rational verifier independently enumerates section vertices and projected polygons, and was inspected for its sampling-vs-proof distinction.
